measure: Compare packed/reference for grouped dispatch, shared/split for activation reuse, and shared/reference for net gain over the deployed arithmetic. Split/packed exposes the cost of changing loop order. No timers inside the projection. All Gate/Up variants materialize both outputs and execute the same SwiGLU. Down receives the same frozen baseline intermediate in a separate block, and every Down label calls the same function. With 1 worker, both baseline and packed execute on the caller.
advance: Require bit equality, an audited load difference, stable controls in each block for both worker counts (Down has five identical labels), and a median <= 0.99 with >= 7 / 10 wins in every block for packed/reference or shared/reference. For shared also require the same bounds on shared/split. Advance an eligible route to model confirmation before changing production.
